The '''''Cardan IV''-class space station''' was the fourth model of [[Cardan-class space station|''Cardan''-class space station]] built for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
These stations supplemented the earlier ''Cardan''-class models. It housed a number of squadrons of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], and could call in nearby [[Acclamator II-class assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator II''-class assault ships]] as well as [[Tartan-class patrol cruiser|''Tartan''-class patrol cruisers]] in the event of an assault on the station.
